item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows Reyansh's steel kettle on a flame and its wooden handle.

Which material choice matches the heat-flow need?

options.A: Steel for the kettle body, because easy heat flow from the flame to the water is wanted.
options.B: Steel for the handle, because reduced heat flow to the hand is wanted.
options.C: Wood for the kettle body, because easy heat flow from the flame to the water is wanted.
options.D: Painting the steel kettle black makes the steel a poor conductor of heat.
